name: SchemeKTheory.ARR.adams_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem adams_prod_one_sub {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (ψ : A →+* A) (j : ℕ) (ℓ : ι → A)
    (hψ : ∀ i ∈ s, ψ (ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ j) :
    ψ (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)) =
      (∏ i ∈ s, ∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, ℓ i ^ a) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)

name: SchemeKTheory.ARR.adams_push_of_koszul
statement:
theorem adams_push_of_koszul {AZ AP : Type*} [CommRing AZ] [CommRing AP]
    (ψZ : AZ →+* AZ) (ψP : AP →+* AP) (p : AZ →+* AP) (s : AP →+* AZ)
    (hsp : ∀ x, s (p x) = x) (hψp : ∀ x, ψP (p x) = p (ψZ x))
    (push : AZ →+ AP) (proj : ∀ y x, push (s y * x) = y * push x)
    (lam tP : AP) (tZ : AZ) (koszul : push 1 = lam) (hlam : ψP lam = tP * lam)
    (ht : s tP = tZ) (x : AZ) :
    ψP (push x) = push (ψZ x * tZ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.chiOp_int
statement:
theorem chiOp_int {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M)
    (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ n, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (m : ℤ) :
    Ψ (evTrunc n H (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (((evTrunc n H tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) v)) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n • w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.chiOp_nat

    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ n, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (m : ℕ) :
    Ψ (evTrunc n H (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (((evTrunc n H tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) v)) =
      ((n + m).choose n : ℚ) • w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.lift
statement:
theorem ConvData.lift {cA cD cB : ℕ → R} (h : ConvData cA cD cB) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : CommRing K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] R) (a d b : ℕ → K),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ (∀ i, φ (a i) = cA i) ∧ (∀ i, φ (d i) = cD i) ∧ (∀ i, φ (b i) = cB i) ∧
      a 0 = 1 ∧ d 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ n, b n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, a p.1 * d p.2)

theorem logDer_mul (f g : PowerSeries K) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.derivative K (f * g) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 =
      PowerSeries.derivative K f * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 +
        PowerSeries.derivative K g * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1

theorem phi_C_mul_X_pow (r : ℕ) (s : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) (a : R) :

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_chernPoly_mul_X_pow

theorem phi_chernPoly_mul_X_pow {r : ℕ} {e s : ℕ → R} (h : SegreInv r e s) (i : ℕ) :
    phi r s (chernPoly r e * X ^ i) = if i = 0 then 1 else 0

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_monomial
statement:
theorem phi_monomial (r : ℕ) (s : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) (a : R) :
    phi r s (monomial k a) = a * (if r ≤ k then s (k - r) else 0)

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.zscore_roots
statement:
theorem zscore_roots (m : Multiset R) (s : ℕ → R)
    (hs : SegreInv (Multiset.card m) (fun j => m.esymm j) s) (D : ℕ) :
    phi (Multiset.card m) s
        ((m.map fun n => 1 - expT D (-(X + C n))).prod) =
      (m.map fun n => uT D n).prod

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_kernelBasis
statement:
theorem exists_kernelBasis (μ : Module.Basis ι A F) (ρ : F →ₗ[A] L) (g : L) (z : ι → A) (j : ι)
    (hz : z j = 1) (hρ : ∀ k, ρ (μ k) = z k • g) (hg : ∀ a : A, a • g = 0 → a = 0)
    (κ : K →ₗ[A] F) (hκ : Function.Injective κ) (hrange : ∀ f, ρ f = 0 → ∃ k, κ k = f)
    (hκρ : ∀ k, ρ (κ k) = 0) :
    ∃ e : Module.Basis {m // m ≠ j} A K, ∀ m, κ (e m) = μ m - z m • μ j

      chRoots A s root * chRoots A t root'

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_one
statement:
theorem chernClassRoots_one (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_two_insert
statement:

    {i : I} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    chernClassRoots A 2 (insert i s) root =
      root i * chernClassRoots A 1 s root + chernClassRoots A 2 s root

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_chRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_chRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (chRoots A s root) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, root i ^ n * algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / Nat.factorial n)

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1
statement:
theorem coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1 (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_chRoots_mul_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_chRoots_mul_toddRoots {J : Type*} (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (root : I → A) (tangentRoot : J → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 1 (chRoots A s root * toddRoots A t tangentRoot) =
      (∑ i ∈ s, root i) +
        (s.card : A) * (∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_toddRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_totalChernRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_totalChernRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    (totalChernRoots A s root).coeff 1 = ∑ i ∈ s, root i

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_chRoots_eq
statement:
theorem coeff_two_chRoots_eq (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (chRoots A s root) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 - 2 * chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_chRoots_mul_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_two_chRoots_mul_toddRoots {J : Type*} (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (root : I → A) (tangentRoot : J → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (chRoots A s root * toddRoots A t tangentRoot) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 - 2 * chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2) +
        (∑ i ∈ s, root i) * (∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2) +
        (s.card : A) *
          (((∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) ^ 2 + chernClassRoots A 2 t tangentRoot) *
            algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12))

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_two_mul (φ ψ : PowerSeries A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (φ * ψ) =
      PowerSeries.coeff 2 φ * PowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ +
        PowerSeries.coeff 1 φ * PowerSeries.coeff 1 ψ +
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ * PowerSeries.coeff 2 ψ

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_two_toddRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (toddRoots A s root) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 + chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12)

    {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ associatedPrimes R R) (x : R)
    {q : Ideal R} (hq : q ∈ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes) :

name: ModuleCat.isSMulRegular_pow
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_pow {x : R} (hx : IsSMulRegular R x) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsSMulRegular R (x ^ n)
  | 0 => IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha => by simpa using ha
  | n + 1 => by
    refine IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha => ?_
    have hx' : x • (x ^ n • a) = 0

name: ModuleCat.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_add_one_of_ofList_cons
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_add_one_of_ofList_cons [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (rs : List R)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + (rs.length + 1) = ringKrullDim R) :
    r ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length =
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r})

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.devissage
statement:
theorem devissage (I : Ideal B) (hart : IsArtinian B (B ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {b})))
    (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (hTmin : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, q.asIdeal ∈ I.minimalPrimes → q ∈ T)
    (hTmem : ∀ q ∈ T, q.asIdeal ∈ I.minimalPrimes)
    (hdim : ∀ q : Ideal B, q.IsPrime → I ≤ q → q ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∨ q.IsMaximal)
    (J : Ideal B) (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    chiCoker b (B ⧸ J) + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ J) * chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
      = chiKer b (B ⧸ J) + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ J) * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.devissage_base
statement:
theorem devissage_base (I : Ideal B) (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (hTmin : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, q.asIdeal ∈ I.minimalPrimes → q ∈ T)
    (hTmem : ∀ q ∈ T, q.asIdeal ∈ I.minimalPrimes)
    (hdim : ∀ q : Ideal B, q.IsPrime → I ≤ q → q ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∨ q.IsMaximal)
    (p : Ideal B) [hp : p.IsPrime] (hIp : I ≤ p) :
    chiCoker b (B ⧸ p) + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p) * chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
      = chiKer b (B ⧸ p) + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p) * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.finsum_ord_add_chiKer
statement:
theorem finsum_ord_add_chiKer {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsNoetherianRing D]
    (Q : Ideal D) [Q.IsPrime] (a s : D) (hs : s ≠ 0) (haQ : a ∈ Q) (hsQ : s ∈ Q)
    (hchain : ∀ q q' : Ideal D, q.IsPrime → q'.IsPrime → ⊥ < q' → q' < q → q < Q → False)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal D, q.IsPrime → q ≤ Q → a ∈ q → s ∈ q → q = Q)
    (q₀ : Ideal D) (hq₀p : q₀.IsPrime) (hq₀b : ⊥ < q₀) (hq₀Q : q₀ < Q) :
    (∑ᶠ q : PrimeSpectrum D, (if q.asIdeal < Q ∧ s ∈ q.asIdeal then
          Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (algebraMap D _ s) *
            Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
                q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) a))
        else 0))
      + chiKer (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) a)
          (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) s})
      = Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
          (Ideal.span {algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) s} ⊔
            Ideal.span {algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) a}))
      ∧ Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
          (Ideal.span {algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) s} ⊔
            Ideal.span {algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime Q) a})) ≠ ⊤

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.local_key
statement:
theorem local_key [IsDomain A] (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal]
    (hlocal : ∀ P : Ideal A, P.IsPrime → P ≤ m) (a s : A) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ham : a ∈ m) (hsm : s ∈ m)
    (hchain : ∀ q q' : Ideal A, q.IsPrime → q'.IsPrime → ⊥ < q' → q' < q → q < m → False)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal A, q.IsPrime → a ∈ q → s ∈ q → q = m)
    (hmnot : m ∉ (Ideal.span {s}).minimalPrimes)
    (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum A))
    (hT : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A, q ∈ T ↔ q.asIdeal ∈ (Ideal.span {s}).minimalPrimes) :
    Module.length A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {s} ⊔ Ideal.span {a}))
      = chiKer a (A ⧸ Ideal.span {s})
        + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {s}) * chiCoker a (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R)

      (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))).asIdeal p.asIdeal
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) rfl) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_principalPullbackSpecIso_hom_comp
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_principalPullbackSpecIso_hom_comp
    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (a : R)
    (z : (pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker (((principalPullbackSpecIso R S a).hom ≫

        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a})))).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalQuotientStalkElement (algebraMap R S a)

statement:
theorem ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes
    {A B C D : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : C →+* D) (eA : A ≃+* C) (eB : B ≃+* D)
    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)

theorem ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes_symm

    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (c : C) (hg : RingHom.ker g = Ideal.span {c}) :
    RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {eA.symm c}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (eZ : Z ≅ Z') (eX : X ≅ X')
    (h : eZ.hom ≫ j = i ≫ eX.hom) (z : Z)
    (a : X'.presheaf.stalk (j (eZ.hom z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalStalkElementOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z a}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square

theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square

    (s : Z' ⟶ Z) (t : X' ⟶ X) (h : s ≫ i = j ≫ t) (z : Z')
    [IsIso (s.stalkMap z)] [IsIso (t.stalkMap (j z))]
    (a : X'.presheaf.stalk (j z))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap (s z)).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z a}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_of_symmetry
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_of_symmetry
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (z : (pullback i f : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker
      ((pullback.fst f i).stalkMap ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)).hom =
        Ideal.span {a}) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.principalStalkElement_commonTarget
statement:
theorem principalStalkElement_commonTarget
    (w : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : U.presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.snd i t
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w))) :
    principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare j (pullback.snd j t)
        (pullback.fst j t) t pullback.condition
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
        ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
          change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
              pullback.snd i t) w =
            (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
              pullback.snd j t) w
          rw [pullback.condition]))).hom a) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
        calc
          i (pullback.fst i t
              (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) =
              t (pullback.snd i t
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            change (pullback.fst i t ≫ i)
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) =
              (pullback.snd i t ≫ t)
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
            rw [pullback.condition]
          _ = t (pullback.snd j t
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            congr 1
            change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
                pullback.snd i t) w =
              (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
                pullback.snd j t) w
            rw [pullback.condition]
          _ = j (pullback.fst j t
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            change (pullback.snd j t ≫ t)
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) =
              (pullback.fst j t ≫ j)
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
            rw [pullback.condition]))).hom
        (principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
          (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) a)

    (K0 : X0.Modules) (K1 : X1.Modules) (K2 : X2.Modules)
    (α : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0 ⟶ K1) (β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).obj K1 ⟶ K2) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f2 ≫ f1)).homEquiv K0 K2
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv.app K0 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2

statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_baseChange_of_degreewise
    {Object' : Type v} {Exact' : Object' → Object' → Object' → Prop}
    {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup B]
    (n : ℕ) (higherClass : Object → ℕ → A)
    (higherClass' : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherClass X) (higherClass Y) (higherClass Z))
    (hlong' : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherClass' X) (higherClass' Y) (higherClass' Z))
    (pullObject : Object → Object')
    (hpull : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      Exact' (pullObject X) (pullObject Y) (pullObject Z))
    (pullTarget : A →+ B)
    (hdegree : ∀ X i, pullTarget (higherClass X i) = higherClass' (pullObject X) i) :
    pullTarget.comp (derivedPushforward n higherClass hlong) =
      (derivedPushforward n higherClass' hlong').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull)

      LongExactWitness n (higherClass X) (higherClass Y) (higherClass Z))
    (X : Object) :
    derivedPushforward n higherClass hlong (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X) =
      alternatingSum n (higherClass X)

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_leray_euler
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_leray_euler
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₁ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₁ (higher₁ X) (higher₁ Y) (higher₁ Z))
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (hlongComposite : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherComposite X) (higherComposite Y) (higherComposite Z))
    (hleray : ∀ X,
      derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ X)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite X))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (derivedPushforward n₁ higher₁ hlong₁ z) =
      derivedPushforward n higherComposite hlongComposite z

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₁ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₁ (higher₁ X) (higher₁ Y) (higher₁ Z))
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (hlongComposite : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherComposite X) (higherComposite Y) (higherComposite Z))
    (hleray : ∀ X,
      derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ X)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite X)) :
    (derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂).comp
        (derivedPushforward n₁ higher₁ hlong₁) =
      derivedPushforward n higherComposite hlongComposite

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (hpush : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → Exact' (push X) (push Y) (push Z))
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (derivedPushforward n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push)
          (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush) z) =
      derivedPushforward n₂ (fun X i => higher₂ (push X) i)
        (fun X Y Z h => hlong₂ _ _ _ (hpush X Y Z h)) z

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (hpush : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → Exact' (push X) (push Y) (push Z))
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z)) :
    (derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂).comp
        (derivedPushforward n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push)
          (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush)) =
      derivedPushforward n₂ (fun X i => higher₂ (push X) i)
        (fun X Y Z h => hlong₂ _ _ _ (hpush X Y Z h))

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_concentrated_eq_map

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hleray_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem hleray_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (X : Object) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (alternatingSum n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push X)) =
      alternatingSum n₂ (fun i => higher₂ (push X) i)

theorem mapOfShortExactFunctorOn_classOf (P : C → Prop) (Q : D → Prop)

statement:
theorem subcategoryClassOf_eq_image_add_image

    (exact : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).Exact)
    (hImageF : P (Abelian.image f)) (hB : P B) (hImageG : P (Abelian.image g)) :
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P B hB =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P (Abelian.image f) hImageF +
        ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P (Abelian.image g) hImageG

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.characteristicClass_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicClass_classOf {C : Type w} [CommRing C]
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ C) (toddClass : C)
    (E : ObjectX) :
    characteristicClass chernCharacter toddClass
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) =
      chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddClass

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.formula_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_object_classes {CX : Type w} {CY : Type x} [CommRing CX] [CommRing CY]
    (F : ObjectX → ObjectY)
    (hF : ∀ A B C, ExactX A B C → ExactY (F A) (F B) (F C))
    (chernX : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectY ExactY →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hobject : ∀ E : ObjectX,
      chernY (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectY ExactY (F E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddX))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX) :
    chernY (ExactGrothendieck.map F hF z) * toddY =
      cyclePushforward (chernX z * toddX)

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_object_classes {CX : Type w} {CY : Type x} [CommRing CX] [CommRing CY]
    (F : ObjectX → ObjectY)
    (hF : ∀ A B C, ExactX A B C → ExactY (F A) (F B) (F C))
    (chernX : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectY ExactY →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hobject : ∀ E : ObjectX,
      chernY (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectY ExactY (F E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddX)) :
    leftHandSide F hF chernY toddY =
      rightHandSide chernX toddX cyclePushforward

statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicNumber_classOf
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ) (E : Object) :
    characteristicNumber chernCharacter toddClass integral
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) =
      integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass)

theorem eulerHom_classOf (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (hadd : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C) (E : Object) :
    eulerHom euler hadd (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) = euler E

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.formula_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_object_classes
    (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (euler_additive : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C)
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Object,
      (euler E : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass))
    (x : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    eulerHom euler euler_additive x =
      integral (chernCharacter x * toddClass)

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_object_classes
    (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (euler_additive : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C)
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Object,
      (euler E : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass)) :
    eulerHom euler euler_additive =
      characteristicNumber chernCharacter toddClass integral

theorem six_term {X₀ X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ X₅ : C} (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ X₁) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ X₃)
    (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ X₄) (f₄ : X₄ ⟶ X₅) [Mono f₀] [Epi f₄]
    (w₁ : f₀ ≫ f₁ = 0) (w₂ : f₁ ≫ f₂ = 0) (w₃ : f₂ ≫ f₃ = 0) (w₄ : f₃ ≫ f₄ = 0)
    (e₁ : (ShortComplex.mk f₀ f₁ w₁).Exact) (e₂ : (ShortComplex.mk f₁ f₂ w₂).Exact)
    (e₃ : (ShortComplex.mk f₂ f₃ w₃).Exact) (e₄ : (ShortComplex.mk f₃ f₄ w₄).Exact)
    (h₀ : P X₀) (h₁ : P X₁) (h₂ : P X₂) (h₃ : P X₃) (h₄ : P X₄) (h₅ : P X₅) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P X₀ h₀ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₁ h₁ +
      subcategoryClassOf C P X₂ h₂ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₃ h₃ +
      subcategoryClassOf C P X₄ h₄ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₅ h₅ = 0

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cartierGysin_classOf (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT hE) -
        subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (kernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_kernel hc hP hT hE)

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono (E : C) (hE : P E) [Mono (ap T σ E)] :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT hE)

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_pushDivisor
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_pushDivisor (F : C) (hF : Killed T σ P F) :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ)
        (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) F hF)) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) F hF -
        subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (T.obj F)
          ⟨hT F hF.1, (hc F).trans (by rw [hF.2, T.map_zero])⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.cartierGysin_comp_map
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_comp_map (c : PushCompat TC σC TD σD Φ) (hobj : ∀ E, PC E → PD (Φ.obj E))
    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → PC S.X₁ → PC S.X₂ → PC S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact)
    (hker : ∀ E, PC E → IsIso (kernelComparison (ap TC σC E) Φ))
    (hcok : ∀ E, PC E → IsIso (cokernelComparison (ap TC σC E) Φ)) :
    (cartierGysin hcD hPD hTD).comp
        (mapOn Φ hobj hΦ) =
      (killedMap c hobj hΦ).comp (cartierGysin hcC hPC hTC)

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.mapOn_classOf
statement:
theorem mapOn_classOf (Φ : C ⥤ D) [Φ.PreservesZeroMorphisms] (hobj : ∀ E, P E → Q (Φ.obj E))
    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₂ → P S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact) (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    mapOn Φ hobj hΦ (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) = subcategoryClassOf D Q (Φ.obj E) (hobj E hE)

statement:

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.pull_cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem pull_cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono {G : C ⥤ D} {H : D ⥤ C} (adj : G ⊣ H)
    [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} G] {Q : D → Prop}
    (hQ0 : Q 0) (pull : SubcategoryGroup C (Killed TC σC PC) →+ SubcategoryGroup D Q)
    (hpull : ∀ K (hK : Killed TC σC PC K), ∃ h : Q (G.obj K),
      pull (subcategoryClassOf C _ K hK) = subcategoryClassOf D Q (G.obj K) h)
    (E : C) (hE : PC E) [Mono (ap TC σC E)] (hH : ap TC σC (H.obj (G.obj E)) = 0)
    (hGE : Q (G.obj E)) :
    pull (cartierGysin hcC hPC hTC (subcategoryClassOf C PC E hE)) =
      subcategoryClassOf D Q (G.obj E) hGE

    (E M : Type u) [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module.Finite R E] [Module.Projective R E]

name: GLocalisation.latticeClass_ses
statement:
theorem latticeClass_ses [IsNoetherianRing R] {N₁ N₂ N₃ : Type u} [AddCommGroup N₁]
    [Module R N₁] [AddCommGroup N₂] [Module R N₂] [AddCommGroup N₃] [Module R N₃]
    (f : N₁ →ₗ[R] N₂) (g : N₂ →ₗ[R] N₃) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hex : Function.Exact f g) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    {L : Submodule R N₂} (hL : IsLattice S L) :
    latticeClass S L hL.1 = latticeClass S (L.comap f) (isLattice_comap S f hf hL).1 +
      latticeClass S (L.map g) (isLattice_map S g hg hL).1

theorem lift_one {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (c : Object → A)

name: ExactGrothendieck.CommutativeTensorData.lift_product

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_add_left
statement:
theorem product_add_left (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (x y z : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight (x + y) z =
      product tensor exactLeft exactRight x z +
        product tensor exactLeft exactRight y z

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_add_right

    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →

    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (x y z : Group Object Exact) :

      product tensor exactLeft exactRight x y +
        product tensor exactLeft exactRight x z

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_assoc_of_classOf
statement:
theorem product_assoc_of_classOf (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (hassoc : ∀ X Y Z,
      classOf Object Exact (tensor (tensor X Y) Z) =
        classOf Object Exact (tensor X (tensor Y Z)))
    (x y z : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight
        (product tensor exactLeft exactRight x y) z =
      product tensor exactLeft exactRight x
        (product tensor exactLeft exactRight y z)

name: KSpecialization.adams_transport
statement:
theorem adams_transport
    {KM KX KP KU KW KZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KX] [AddCommGroup KP]
    [AddCommGroup KU] [CommRing KW] [CommRing KZ]
    (Fp : KW →+ KM) (ip : KZ →+ KX) (sp : KZ →+ KP) (πp : KP →+ KZ)
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KX) (jP : KM →+ KP) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ) (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (ψM : KM →+ KM) (ψX : KX →+ KX) (ψP : KP →+ KP) (ψU : KU →+ KU)
    (ψW : KW →+ KW) (ψZ : KZ →+ KZ) (θW : KW) (θZ : KZ)
    (hsupp : ∀ m, res m = 0 → ∃ w, Fp w = m)
    (hresψ : ∀ m, res (ψM m) = ψU (res m)) (hresF : ∀ w, res (Fp w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jP (Fp w) = sp (r₁ w))
    (hψ₀ : ∀ m, j₀ (ψM m) = ψX (j₀ m)) (hψP : ∀ m, jP (ψM m) = ψP (jP m))
    (hψr₀ : ∀ w, r₀ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₀ w)) (hψr₁ : ∀ w, r₁ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₁ w))
    (hθ₀ : r₀ θW = θZ) (hθ₁ : r₁ θW = θZ)
    (hpr₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (hpr₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z, ψP (sp z) = sp (θZ * ψZ z))
    (hπs : ∀ z, πp (sp z) = z) (hrigid : r₀ = r₁) (x : KZ) :
    ψX (ip x) = ip (θZ * ψZ x)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E))) :
    (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase).comp (indexClass push hpush) =
      (indexClass push' hpush').comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_indexClass_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_indexClass_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E)))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Total ExactTotal) :
    ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase (indexClass push hpush z) =
      indexClass push' hpush' (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal z)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.indexClass_classOf

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_kernelLift_chart
statement:
theorem isIso_kernelLift_chart {Om B Lm Lm' Q Un : D} {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (m a : ℕ) (ha : a < m) (e : I → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, e k < m) (hea : ∀ k, e k ≠ a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective e) (hsurj : ∀ j, j < m → j ≠ a → ∃ k, e k = j)
    (pr : ℕ → (B ⟶ Lm)) (inj : ℕ → (Lm ⟶ B))
    (hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr j ≫ inj j = 𝟙 B)
    (ψ : Om ⟶ B) (τ : Lm ≅ Un) (co : I → (Om ⟶ Un)) (fr : I → (Un ⟶ Om))
    (hfr : ∀ i j, fr i ≫ co j = if i = j then 𝟙 Un else 0)
    (hco : ∑ k, co k ≫ fr k = 𝟙 Om)
    (hbr : ∀ k, ψ ≫ pr (e k) ≫ τ.hom = co k)
    (x : ℕ → (Lm ⟶ Lm')) (heuler : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (ψ ≫ pr j) ≫ x j = 0)
    (hxa : IsIso (x a))
    (d : B ⟶ Q) (w : Q ≅ Lm') (hd : d ≫ w.hom = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr j ≫ x j)
    [HasKernel d] (hψd : ψ ≫ d = 0) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift d ψ hψd)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ)
    (rank' : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base' ExactBase' →+ ℤ)
    (hindex :
      (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase).comp (indexClass push hpush) =
        (indexClass push' hpush').comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal))
    (hrank : rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase) = rank) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank =
      (familyEuler push' hpush' rank').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ)
    (rank' : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base' ExactBase' →+ ℤ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E)))
    (hrank : rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase) = rank) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank =
      (familyEuler push' hpush' rank').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem familyEuler_classOf (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ) (E : Total) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Total ExactTotal E) =
      rank (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base ExactBase (push E))

    (F : Type u) [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [Module.Finite R F] (hF : IsSMulRegular F t)
    (n : ℕ)

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N] [Module R N]
      [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N],
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N) n →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R N) (n + f.length)
  | 0, N, _, _, _, _, h => by
    rw [← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero, ← IsProjective.iff_projective] at h
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient f hf N
  | n + 1, N, _, _, _, _, h => by
    let π := Finsupp.linearCombination (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (id : N → N)
    have surj : Function.Surjective π :=
      Finsupp.linearCombination_surjective _ Function.surjective_id
    have hSA := LinearMap.shortExact_shortComplexKer surj
    haveI : Projective (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (N →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f))

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular :
    ∀ (f : List R) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M], IsWeaklyRegular M f →
      ∀ n : ℕ, HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R M) n →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLT
          (ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ (Ideal.ofList f • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))) (n + f.length)
  | [], M, _, _, _, n, h => by
    have e : M ≃ₗ[R] M ⧸ (Ideal.ofList ([] : List R) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) :=
      (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot _ (by rw [Ideal.ofList_nil, Submodule.bot_smul])).symm
    simpa using hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.toModuleIso n
  | x :: f, M, _, _, reg, n, h => by
    rw [isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff] at reg
    haveI

name: RG6B.E1_to_E2_todd
statement:
theorem E1_to_E2_todd (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (chi : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) (hb : ∀ k, b k ∈ W 1) {t s : K} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : Fintype.card ι = d + Fintype.card κ)
    (ht : t * ∏ i, th j D (a i) = ∏ k, th j D (b k))
    (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t) (hs0 : pr W 0 s = 1)
    (hE1 : ∀ x, chi x = chi (t * psi x)) :
    ∃ τ τi : K, τ * ∏ k, Td D (b k) = ∏ i, Td D (a i) ∧ pr W 0 τ = 1 ∧ psi τ = s * τ ∧
      τ * τi = 1 ∧ (∀ {p : ℕ} {w : K}, w ∈ W p → p ≠ d → chi (w * τi) = 0) ∧
      (∀ w, chi (psi w * τi) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (w * τi)) ∧
      (∀ x, chi x = chi (pr W d (x * τ) * τi))

name: MinorsSat.mul_adjugate_apply
statement:
theorem mul_adjugate_apply (i : m) (s : ι) :
    (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) i s =
      (φ.submatrix (Function.update S₀ s i) T₀).det

name: MinorsSat.mul_adjugate_mem
statement:
theorem mul_adjugate_mem (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) (i : m) (s : ι) :
    ∃ b : A, b * (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det =
      (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) i s

name: MinorsSat.satMat_factor
statement:
theorem satMat_factor (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det})
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    φ = satMat hgen * φ.submatrix S₀ id

name: MinorsSat.satMat_rows_one
statement:
theorem satMat_rows_one (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) :
    (satMat hgen).submatrix S₀ id = 1

name: MinorsSat.smul_eq_mul_adjugate_mul
statement:
theorem smul_eq_mul_adjugate_mul (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • φ =
      (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) * φ.submatrix S₀ id

name: MinorsSat.smul_satMat
statement:
theorem smul_satMat (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) :
    (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • satMat hgen =
      φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)

statement:
@[simp] lemma adm_cons {P T : Submodule A M} {v : M} {l : List M} :
    Adm P T (v :: l) ↔ v ∈ T ∧ v ∉ P ∧ MKill P v ∧ Adm (P ⊔ A ∙ v) T l

name: FinLenDet.adm_erase
statement:
lemma adm_erase {f : M} : ∀ {P T : Submodule A M} {l₁ l₂ : List M} {x : M},
    Adm P T (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) → MKill P f → f ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ → f ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ x →
    Adm (P ⊔ A ∙ f) T (l₁ ++ l₂)
  | P, T, [], l₂, x, h, hf, h1, h2 => by
    simp only [lspan_nil, sup_bot_eq, List.nil_append] at h h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [sup_span_eq_of_mem h.2.2.1 h2 h1]; exact h.2.2.2
  | P, T, a :: l₁, l₂, x, h, hf, h1, h2 => by
    rw [sup_lspan_cons] at h1 h2
    have ih

name: FinLenDet.boundary_ratio
statement:
lemma boundary_ratio (g : M →ₗ[A] M') (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ g) (hψ : g ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ g)
    (h : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M) ⊤ φ ψ) (h' : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M') ⊤ φ' ψ')
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker φ) (hKψ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range g) (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range g)
    {w Y : List M'} {z₀ z₀'' x₀ : List M} (hz₀ : Adm ⊥ (LinearMap.ker g) z₀)
    (hz'' : z₀''.map ψ = z₀) (hx : Adm (LinearMap.ker g) (LinearMap.range φ) (x₀.map φ))
    (hw : Adm (LinearMap.range g) ⊤ w) (hY : Adm (LinearMap.range φ') ⊤ (Y ++ w))
    (s₁ : M' → M) (hs₁ : ∀ x, g (s₁ x) = φ' x) :
    ratio ⊥ ⊤ ((x₀.map φ).map g ++ (w.map φ' ++ (Y ++ w)))
        ((x₀.map φ).map g ++ (z₀''.map g ++ (Y ++ w))) =
      ratio ⊥ (LinearMap.ker g) ((w.map s₁).map ψ) z₀

name: FinLenDet.exists_lift
statement:
lemma exists_lift (φ : M →ₗ[A] M) (T : Submodule A M) :
    ∀ l : List M, (∀ v ∈ l, v ∈ T.map φ) → ∃ X : List M, X.map φ = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ X, x ∈ T
  | [], _ => ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩
  | v :: l, h => by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

statement:
lemma exists_mkill [IsArtinian A M] {P T : Submodule A M} (h : P < T) :

name: FinLenDet.exists_split
statement:
lemma exists_split {P : Submodule A M} {g : M} :
    ∀ {l : List M}, g ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l → g ∉ P →
      ∃ l₁ x l₂, l = l₁ ++ x :: l₂ ∧ g ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ∧ g ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ x
  | [], h, hg => by simp at h; exact absurd h hg
  | v :: l, h, hg => by
    by_cases hv : g ∈ P ⊔ A ∙ v
    · exact ⟨[], v, l, rfl, by simpa using hg, by simpa using hv⟩
    · rw [sup_lspan_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨l₁, x, l₂, rfl, h1, h2⟩

name: FinLenDet.map_exact_aux
statement:
lemma map_exact_aux (g : M →ₗ[A] M') {φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[A] M'} (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ g)

name: FinLenDet.move_block
statement:
lemma move_block {P T S : Submodule A M} (X l₂ : List M) {Y : List M} :
    ∀ {l₀ : List M}, Adm (P ⊔ lspan A l₀) S Y → Adm P T (l₀ ++ X ++ Y ++ l₂) →
      Adm P T (l₀ ++ Y ++ X ++ l₂) ∧ ∀ c, IsVol P T c →
        c (l₀ ++ X ++ Y ++ l₂) = (-1) ^ (X.length * Y.length) * c (l₀ ++ Y ++ X ++ l₂)

name: FinLenDet.perDet_comp
statement:
theorem perDet_comp (hαβ : α ∘ₗ β = β ∘ₗ α) (hαγ : α ∘ₗ γ = γ ∘ₗ α) (hβγ : β ∘ₗ γ = γ ∘ₗ β)
    (h1 : LinearMap.range α = LinearMap.ker (β ∘ₗ γ))
    (h2 : LinearMap.ker α = LinearMap.range (β ∘ₗ γ))
    (h4 : LinearMap.ker β = LinearMap.range (α ∘ₗ γ))
    (h5 : LinearMap.range γ = LinearMap.ker (α ∘ₗ β)) :
    perDet ⊥ ⊤ α (β ∘ₗ γ) =
      perDet ⊥ (LinearMap.range γ) α β * perDet (LinearMap.ker β) ⊤ α γ

name: FinLenDet.perDet_eq
statement:
theorem perDet_eq (h : PerExact P T φ ψ) {X Y : List M} (hc : IsChoice P T φ ψ X Y) :
    perDet P T φ ψ = (-1) ^ (X.length * Y.length) * ratio P T (X.map φ ++ Y) (Y.map ψ ++ X)

name: FinLenDet.perDet_eq_of_boundary
statement:
theorem perDet_eq_of_boundary (g : M →ₗ[A] M') (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ g)
    (hψ : g ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ g)
    (h : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M) ⊤ φ ψ) (h' : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M') ⊤ φ' ψ')
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker φ) (hKψ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range g) (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range g)
    (hbd : ∀ (m' : M') (m₁ m₂ : M), g m₁ = φ' m' → g m₂ = ψ' m' → ψ m₁ = φ m₂) :
    perDet ⊥ ⊤ φ' ψ' = perDet ⊥ ⊤ φ ψ

name: FinLenDet.perDet_equiv
statement:
theorem perDet_equiv (e : M ≃ₗ[A] M') {φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[A] M'} (hφ : e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ e)
    (hψ : e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ e) (h : PerExact P T φ ψ) :
    perDet (P.map e.toLinearMap) (T.map e.toLinearMap) φ' ψ' = perDet P T φ ψ

name: FinLenDet.perDet_map

theorem perDet_map (g : M →ₗ[A] M') {φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[A] M'} (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ g)

name: FinLenDet.perDet_self
statement:
theorem perDet_self (h : PerExact P T φ φ) {X : List M} (hX : Adm P (T.map φ ⊔ P) (X.map φ))
    (hXT : ∀ x ∈ X, x ∈ T) : perDet P T φ φ = (-1) ^ X.length

name: FinLenDet.perDet_symm
statement: theorem perDet_symm (h : PerExact P T φ ψ) : perDet P T ψ φ = (perDet P T φ ψ)⁻¹

name: FinLenDet.perDet_unit_zero
statement:
theorem perDet_unit_zero {u : A} (hu : IsUnit u) {X : List M} (hX : Adm P T X) :
    perDet P T (u • LinearMap.id) 0 = residue A u ^ X.length

name: FinLenDet.perDet_zero_left
statement:
theorem perDet_zero_left (h : PerExact P T 0 ψ) {Y : List M} (hY : Adm P T (Y.map ψ))
    (hYT : ∀ y ∈ Y, y ∈ T) : perDet P T 0 ψ = (ratio P T (Y.map ψ) Y)⁻¹

name: FinLenDet.perDet_zero_right
statement:
theorem perDet_zero_right (h : PerExact P T φ 0) {X : List M} (hX : Adm P T (X.map φ))
    (hXT : ∀ x ∈ X, x ∈ T) : perDet P T φ 0 = ratio P T (X.map φ) X

name: FinLenDet.perExact_bot_top_iff
statement:
lemma perExact_bot_top_iff :
    PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M) ⊤ φ ψ ↔
      LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range ψ ∧ LinearMap.ker ψ = LinearMap.range φ

name: FinLenDet.perExact_unit_zero
statement:
lemma perExact_unit_zero {u : A} (hu : IsUnit u) (hPT : P ≤ T) :
    PerExact P T (u • LinearMap.id) 0

name: FinLenDet.ratio_append
statement:
lemma ratio_append {l₁ l₁' l₂ l₂' : List M} (h₁ : Adm P S l₁) (h₁' : Adm P S l₁')
    (h₂ : Adm S T l₂) (h₂' : Adm S T l₂') :
    ratio P T (l₁ ++ l₂) (l₁' ++ l₂') = ratio P S l₁ l₁' * ratio S T l₂ l₂'

name: FinLenDet.ratio_append_left
statement:
lemma ratio_append_left {l₀ : List M} (h₀ : Adm P S l₀) (hl : Adm S T l) (hl' : Adm S T l') :
    ratio P T (l₀ ++ l) (l₀ ++ l') = ratio S T l l'

name: FinLenDet.ratio_append_right
statement:
lemma ratio_append_right {l₀ : List M} (h₀ : Adm S T l₀) (hl : Adm P S l) (hl' : Adm P S l') :
    ratio P T (l ++ l₀) (l' ++ l₀) = ratio P S l l'

name: FinLenDet.ratio_eq_div
statement:
theorem ratio_eq_div {c : List M → ResidueField A} (hc : IsVol P T c) (hl : Adm P T l)
    (hl' : Adm P T l') (hc' : c l' ≠ 0) : ratio P T l l' = c l / c l'

name: FinLenDet.ratio_map
FinLenDet.ratio_move_block
statement:
lemma ratio_move_block {X Y l₀ l₂ : List M} (hY : Adm (P ⊔ lspan A l₀) S Y)
    (h : Adm P T (l₀ ++ X ++ Y ++ l₂)) :
    ratio P T (l₀ ++ X ++ Y ++ l₂) l' =
      (-1) ^ (X.length * Y.length) * ratio P T (l₀ ++ Y ++ X ++ l₂) l'

name: FinLenDet.ratio_mul_ratio
statement:
lemma ratio_mul_ratio (hl' : Adm P T l') :
    ratio P T l l' * ratio P T l' l'' = ratio P T l l''

name: FinLenDet.ratio_mul_ratio_symm
statement:
lemma ratio_mul_ratio_symm (hl : Adm P T l) (hl' : Adm P T l') :
    ratio P T l l' * ratio P T l' l = 1

name: FinLenDet.ratio_ne_zero
statement: lemma ratio_ne_zero (hl : Adm P T l) (hl' : Adm P T l') : ratio P T l l' ≠ 0

name: FinLenDet.ratio_self
statement: lemma ratio_self (hl : Adm P T l) : ratio P T l l = 1

name: FinLenDet.ratio_smul_unit
statement:
lemma ratio_smul_unit {u : A} (hu : IsUnit u) (hl : Adm P T l) :
    ratio P T (l.map (u • ·)) l = residue A u ^ l.length

name: FinLenDet.self_mem_sup_span
statement: lemma self_mem_sup_span (B : Submodule A M) (v : M) : v ∈ B ⊔ A ∙ v

name: FinLenDet.splitVal_eq
statement:
lemma splitVal_eq {P : Submodule A M} {f : M} {c' : List M → ResidueField A} {l₁ l₂ : List M}
    {x : M} (h1 : f ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁) (h2 : f ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ x) :
    splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) =
      (-1) ^ l₁.length * coef (P ⊔ lspan A l₁) x f * c' (l₁ ++ l₂)

name: FinLenDet.splitVal_ne_zero
statement:
lemma splitVal_ne_zero (hf : MKill P f) (hfP : f ∉ P) (hfT : f ∈ T)
    (hc'0 : ∀ l, Adm (P ⊔ A ∙ f) T l → c' l ≠ 0) {l : List M} (hl : Adm P T l) :
    splitVal P f c' l ≠ 0

name: FinLenDet.splitVal_smul
statement:
lemma splitVal_smul (hf : MKill P f) (hfP : f ∉ P) (hfT : f ∈ T) (hc' : IsVol (P ⊔ A ∙ f) T c')
    (l₁ l₂ : List M) (v w x : M) (a : A) (h : Adm P T (l₁ ++ v :: l₂))
    (h' : Adm P T (l₁ ++ w :: l₂)) (hx : x ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁) (he : v = a • w + x) :
    splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ v :: l₂) = residue A a * splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ w :: l₂)

name: FinLenDet.splitVal_swap
statement:
lemma splitVal_swap (hf : MKill P f) (hfP : f ∉ P) (hfT : f ∈ T) (hc' : IsVol (P ⊔ A ∙ f) T c')
    (l₁ l₂ : List M) (u v : M) (h : Adm P T (l₁ ++ u :: v :: l₂))
    (h' : Adm P T (l₁ ++ v :: u :: l₂)) :
    splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ u :: v :: l₂) = - splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ v :: u :: l₂)

name: FinLenDet.splitVal_swap_caseB
statement:
lemma splitVal_swap_caseB (hf : MKill P f) {l₁ l₂ : List M} {u v : M}
    (h : Adm P T (l₁ ++ u :: v :: l₂)) (h' : Adm P T (l₁ ++ v :: u :: l₂))
    (hA : f ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁) (hU : f ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ u) :
    splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ u :: v :: l₂) = - splitVal P f c' (l₁ ++ v :: u :: l₂)

name: FinLenDet.split_unique
statement:
lemma split_unique {g : M} {l₂ k₂ : List M} {x y : M} {l₁ : List M} :
    ∀ {P : Submodule A M} {k₁ : List M}, l₁ ++ x :: l₂ = k₁ ++ y :: k₂ →
    g ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ → g ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ x →
    g ∉ P ⊔ lspan A k₁ → g ∈ P ⊔ lspan A k₁ ⊔ A ∙ y → l₁ = k₁ ∧ x = y ∧ l₂ = k₂

name: FinLenDet.sup_lspan_append
statement:
lemma sup_lspan_append (P : Submodule A M) (l₁ l₂ : List M) :
    P ⊔ lspan A (l₁ ++ l₂) = P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ lspan A l₂

name: FinLenDet.sup_lspan_cons
statement:
lemma sup_lspan_cons (P : Submodule A M) (v : M) (l : List M) :
    P ⊔ lspan A (v :: l) = P ⊔ A ∙ v ⊔ lspan A l

name: FinLenDet.sup_lspan_erase
statement:
lemma sup_lspan_erase {P : Submodule A M} {f x : M} {l₁ l₂ : List M}
    (hx : MKill (P ⊔ lspan A l₁) x) (h1 : f ∉ P ⊔ lspan A l₁)
    (h2 : f ∈ P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ x) :
    P ⊔ lspan A (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) = P ⊔ A ∙ f ⊔ lspan A (l₁ ++ l₂)

name: FinLenDet.sup_lspan_mid
statement:
lemma sup_lspan_mid (P : Submodule A M) (l₁ k₁ : List M) (z : M) :
    P ⊔ lspan A (l₁ ++ z :: k₁) = P ⊔ lspan A l₁ ⊔ A ∙ z ⊔ lspan A k₁

name: FinLenDet.sup_lspan_snoc
statement:
lemma sup_lspan_snoc (P : Submodule A M) (l : List M) (v : M) :
    P ⊔ lspan A (l ++ [v]) = P ⊔ lspan A l ⊔ A ∙ v

name: FinLenDet.sup_span_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma sup_span_eq_of_mem {P : Submodule A M} {v w : M} (hv : MKill P v)
    (hw : w ∈ P ⊔ A ∙ v) (hwP : w ∉ P) : P ⊔ A ∙ w = P ⊔ A ∙ v

name: FinLenDet.top_map_sup_bot
statement:
lemma top_map_sup_bot {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (f : M →ₗ[A] N) :
    (⊤ : Submodule A M).map f ⊔ ⊥ = LinearMap.range f

name: FinLenDet.vol0_ne_zero
statement: lemma vol0_ne_zero {P T : Submodule A M} {l : List M} (hl : Adm P T l) : vol0 P T l ≠ 0

name: FinLenDet.vol_eq_ratio_mul
statement:
theorem vol_eq_ratio_mul {c : List M → ResidueField A} (hc : IsVol P T c) (hl : Adm P T l)
    (hl' : Adm P T l') : c l = ratio P T l l' * c l'

name: FinLenDet.vol_smul_unit
statement:
lemma vol_smul_unit {u : A} (hu : IsUnit u) {P T : Submodule A M} {c : List M → ResidueField A}
    (hc : IsVol P T c) (l : List M) :
    ∀ {l₀ : List M}, Adm P T (l₀ ++ l) →
      c (l₀ ++ l.map (u • ·)) = residue A u ^ l.length * c (l₀ ++ l)

name: FinLenDet.vol_unique
statement:
theorem vol_unique {T : Submodule A M} {l' : List M} :
    ∀ {l : List M} {P : Submodule A M}, Adm P T l → Adm P T l' →
      ∃ μ : ResidueField A, (∀ c, IsVol P T c → c l = μ * c l') ∧ l.length = l'.length

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.algebraMap_ne_zero_of_atPrime
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ne_zero_of_atPrime {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] (P : Ideal S)
    [P.IsPrime] (D : Type*) [CommRing D] [Algebra S D] [IsLocalization.AtPrime D P]
    {b : S} (hb : b ≠ 0) : algebraMap S D b ≠ 0

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.comap_eq_maximalIdeal
statement: theorem comap_eq_maximalIdeal (t : T) : (Q t).comap (algebraMap A B) = maximalIdeal A

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.isLocalization_atPrime_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isLocalization_atPrime_maximalIdeal (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    IsLocalization.AtPrime A (maximalIdeal A)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.length_quot_toNat_eq
statement:
theorem length_quot_toNat_eq (x : B) :
    (Module.length A (B ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).toNat =
      (Ring.ord B x).toNat * resDeg A B

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem ordFrac_algebraMap_eq {x : B} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac B (algebraMap B L x) =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Ring.ord B x).toNat : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_ofAdd_sum
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_ofAdd_sum
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : S) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L b)) =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((∑ t, (Ring.ord (D t) (algebraMap S (D t) b)).toNat *
        resDeg A (D t) : ℕ) : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : L) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K b) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) b ^ resDeg A (D t)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_local
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_local
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal B, Q'.IsMaximal → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : L) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K b) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) b ^ resDeg A (D t)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : S) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L b)) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) (algebraMap S L b) ^ resDeg A (D t)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.prod_coe_ofAdd_pow
statement:
theorem prod_coe_ofAdd_pow {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (n d : T → ℕ) :
    ∏ t, ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (n t : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰) ^ d t =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((∑ t, n t * d t : ℕ) : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.toNat_sum_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem toNat_sum_of_ne_top {T : Type*} (s : Finset T) (f : T → ℕ∞)
    (h : ∑ t ∈ s, f t ≠ ⊤) : (∑ t ∈ s, f t).toNat = ∑ t ∈ s, (f t).toNat

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.algebraMap_germ_ratSec
statement:
theorem algebraMap_germ_ratSec (g : X.functionField) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ ratLocus g) :
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField
      (X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) y hy (ratSec g)) = g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.denIdealSheaf_ideal
statement:
theorem denIdealSheaf_ideal (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (denIdealSheaf g).ideal U = denIdeal g U.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.denIdeal_map_basicOpen
statement:
theorem denIdeal_map_basicOpen (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (denIdeal g U.1).map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom =
      denIdeal g (X.basicOpen s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.eq_bot_of_genericPoint_notMem
statement: theorem eq_bot_of_genericPoint_notMem {W : X.Opens} (hη : genericPoint X ∉ W) : W = ⊥

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.exists_mem_denIdeal_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mem_denIdeal_ne_zero (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens)
    [Nonempty U.1] : ∃ b ∈ denIdeal g U.1, b ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_of_mem
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_of_mem {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) : genericPoint X ∈ W

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_ratLocus
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_ratLocus (g : X.functionField) : genericPoint X ∈ ratLocus g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.germ_ratSec
statement:
theorem germ_ratSec (g : X.functionField) (hη : genericPoint X ∈ ratLocus g) :
    X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) (genericPoint X) hη (ratSec g) = g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.le_ratLocus
statement:
theorem le_ratLocus [IrreducibleSpace X] {g : X.functionField} {W : X.Opens} (h : RegOn g W) :
    W ≤ ratLocus g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_denIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_denIdeal {g : X.functionField} {U : X.Opens} {a : Γ(X, U)} :
    a ∈ denIdeal g U ↔ ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ U, ∃ b : Γ(X, U),
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη b = X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη a * g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_denIdeal_inv
statement:
theorem mem_denIdeal_inv {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) {U : X.Opens} {a b : Γ(X, U)}
    (hab : ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ U,
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη b = X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη a * g) :
    b ∈ denIdeal g⁻¹ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_iff {g : X.functionField} {y : X} :
    y ∈ ratLocus g ↔ ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk y,
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField a = g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_inv_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_inv_of_isUnit {g : X.functionField} {y : X} (hy : y ∈ ratLocus g)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) y hy (ratSec g))) : y ∈ ratLocus g⁻¹

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap {g : X.functionField} {y : X} (a : X.presheaf.stalk y)
    (ha : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField a = g) : y ∈ ratLocus g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratSec_mul_ratSec_inv
statement:
theorem ratSec_mul_ratSec_inv {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ratSec g |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) * ratSec g⁻¹ |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) = 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.regOn_ratLocus
statement: theorem regOn_ratLocus (g : X.functionField) : RegOn g (ratLocus g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.sec_ext
statement:
theorem sec_ext {W : X.Opens} {c c' : Γ(X, W)}
    (h : ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ W,
      X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hη c = X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hη c') :
    c = c'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.subsingleton_sec
statement: theorem subsingleton_sec {W : X.Opens} (hη : genericPoint X ∉ W) : Subsingleton Γ(X, W)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.addVal_eq_ord
statement:
theorem addVal_eq_ord {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : Kˣ) (hx : (x : K) = algebraMap R K r) :
    0 ≤ ord R x ∧ addVal R r = ((ord R x).toNat : ℕ∞)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) :
    algebraMap R K ϖ ≠ 0

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_tameUnit
statement:
theorem algebraMap_tameUnit (a b : Kˣ) :
    algebraMap R K (tameUnit R a b : R) =
      (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) * (a : K) ^ ord R b / (b : K) ^ ord R a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_unitPart_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_unitPart_of_ord_eq_zero (a : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    algebraMap R K (unitPart R a : R) = a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_units_zpow
statement:
theorem algebraMap_units_zpow (v : Rˣ) (k : ℤ) :
    algebraMap R K ((v ^ k : Rˣ) : R) = algebraMap R K (v : R) ^ k

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_eq_unitPart_smul
statement:
theorem coe_eq_unitPart_smul (x : Kˣ) :
    (x : K) = unitPart R x • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ ord R x

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.exists_smul_zpow_unif
statement:
theorem exists_smul_zpow_unif (x : Kˣ) :
    ∃ (n : ℤ) (u : Rˣ), (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.irreducible_unif
statement: theorem irreducible_unif : Irreducible (unif R)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.length_quotient_span_eq_ord
statement:
theorem length_quotient_span_eq_ord {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : Kˣ)
    (hx : (x : K) = algebraMap R K r) :
    Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) = ((ord R x).toNat : ℕ∞)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.neg_one_zpow_mul_self
statement:
theorem neg_one_zpow_mul_self {G : Type*} [Monoid G] [HasDistribNeg G] (u : Gˣ) (n : ℤ)
    (hu : u = -1) : u ^ (n * n) = u ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_eq_of_eq_smul_zpow
statement:
theorem ord_eq_of_eq_smul_zpow {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {x : Kˣ} {n : ℤ} {u : Rˣ}
    (h : (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ n) : ord R x = n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_inv
statement: theorem ord_inv (x : Kˣ) : ord R x⁻¹ = - ord R x

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_mul
statement: theorem ord_mul (x y : Kˣ) : ord R (x * y) = ord R x + ord R y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_one
statement: theorem ord_one : ord R (1 : Kˣ) = 0

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_eq
statement:
theorem ord_unitPart_eq {x : Kˣ} {n : ℤ} {u : Rˣ}
    (h : (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ n) : ord R x = n ∧ unitPart R x = u

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_mul
statement:
theorem ord_unitPart_mul (x y : Kˣ) :
    ord R (x * y) = ord R x + ord R y ∧ unitPart R (x * y) = unitPart R x * unitPart R y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_one
statement: theorem ord_unitPart_one : ord R (1 : Kˣ) = 0 ∧ unitPart R (1 : Kˣ) = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_zpow
statement: theorem ord_zpow (x : Kˣ) (k : ℤ) : ord R (x ^ k) = k * ord R x

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.smul_zpow_inj
statement:
theorem smul_zpow_inj {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {n m : ℤ} {u v : Rˣ}
    (h : u • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ n = v • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ m) : n = m ∧ u = v

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.smul_zpow_mul_smul_zpow
statement:
theorem smul_zpow_mul_smul_zpow (π : K) (hπ : π ≠ 0) (u v : Rˣ) (n m : ℤ) :
    (u • π ^ n) * (v • π ^ m) = (u * v) • π ^ (n + m)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_left
statement:
theorem tameUnit_mul_left (a a' b : Kˣ) :
    tameUnit R (a * a') b = tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R a' b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_right
statement:
theorem tameUnit_mul_right (a b b' : Kˣ) :
    tameUnit R a (b * b') = tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R a b'

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap
statement: theorem tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R b a = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tameUnit_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    tameUnit R a b = unitPart R a ^ ord R b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_self
statement: theorem tameUnit_self (a : Kˣ) : tameUnit R a a = (-1) ^ ord R a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_swap
statement: theorem tameUnit_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tameUnit R b a = (tameUnit R a b)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_eq_residue
statement:
theorem tame_eq_residue (a b : Kˣ) (c : R)
    (hc : algebraMap R K c = (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) * (a : K) ^ ord R b / (b : K) ^ ord R a) :
    (tame R a b : ResidueField R) = residue R c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_eq_residue_tameUnit
statement:
theorem tame_eq_residue_tameUnit (a b : Kˣ) :
    (tame R a b : ResidueField R) = residue R (tameUnit R a b : R)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_left
statement: theorem tame_mul_left (a a' b : Kˣ) : tame R (a * a') b = tame R a b * tame R a' b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_right
statement: theorem tame_mul_right (a b b' : Kˣ) : tame R a (b * b') = tame R a b * tame R a b'

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_tame_swap
statement: theorem tame_mul_tame_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tame R a b * tame R b a = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tame_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    tame R a b = Units.map (residue R : R →* ResidueField R) (unitPart R a) ^ ord R b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_of_ord_eq_zero_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tame_of_ord_eq_zero_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) (hb : ord R b = 0) :
    tame R a b = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_self
statement: theorem tame_self (a : Kˣ) : tame R a a = (-1) ^ ord R a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_swap
statement: theorem tame_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tame R b a = (tame R a b)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_inv
statement: theorem unitPart_inv (x : Kˣ) : unitPart R x⁻¹ = (unitPart R x)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_mul
statement: theorem unitPart_mul (x y : Kˣ) : unitPart R (x * y) = unitPart R x * unitPart R y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_one
statement: theorem unitPart_one : unitPart R (1 : Kˣ) = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_zpow
statement: theorem unitPart_zpow (x : Kˣ) (k : ℤ) : unitPart R (x ^ k) = unitPart R x ^ k

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_dB
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_dB (a b : B) : (dB a b : ResidueField B) = symb a b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_unitOf
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_unitOf (a : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (unitOf K a ha : K) = algebraMap B K a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.comp_mulQ
statement: theorem comp_mulQ {z w : B} (g : Qt z →ₗ[B] Qt w) (x : B) : g ∘ₗ mulQ z x = mulQ w x ∘ₗ g

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dBHom_mul
statement:
theorem dBHom_mul {a a' : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    (dBHom (K := K) (a * a')) = dBHom a * dBHom a'

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_eq_tame
statement:
theorem dB_eq_tame {a b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    dB a b = tame R (unitOf K a ha) (unitOf K b hb)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_dB_swap
statement: theorem dB_mul_dB_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : dB a b * dB b a = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_left
statement:
theorem dB_mul_left {a a' : B} (b : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    dB (a * a') b = dB a b * dB a' b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_right
statement:
theorem dB_mul_right (a : B) {b c : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    dB a (b * c) = dB a b * dB a c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_pow_left
statement: theorem dB_pow_left {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : B) (n : ℕ) : dB (a ^ n) b = dB a b ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_pow_right
statement: theorem dB_pow_right (a : B) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : dB a (b ^ n) = dB a b ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_self
statement: theorem dB_self {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B a = n) : dB a a = (-1) ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_self'
statement: theorem dB_self' {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) : dB a a = (-1) ^ (Ring.ord B a).toNat

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_swap
statement: theorem dB_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : dB b a = (dB a b)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_unit
statement:
theorem dB_unit (u : Bˣ) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B b = n) :
    dB (u : B) b = Units.map (residue B : B →* ResidueField B) u ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_eq_tame
statement: theorem dK_eq_tame (x y : Kˣ) : dK R K x y = tame R x y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_eq_tameHom
statement: theorem dK_eq_tameHom : dK R K = tameHom R K

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_mul_dK_swap
statement: theorem dK_mul_dK_swap (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K x y * dK B K y x = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self
statement: theorem dK_self (x : Kˣ) : dK B K x x = (-1) ^ (Multiplicative.toAdd (ordZ B K x))

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self_inv
statement: theorem dK_self_inv (x : Kˣ) : dK B K x⁻¹ x⁻¹ = dK B K x x

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self_mul
statement: theorem dK_self_mul (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K (x * y) (x * y) = dK B K x x * dK B K y y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_swap
statement: theorem dK_swap (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K y x = (dK B K x y)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_unitOf
statement:
theorem dK_unitOf {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    dK B K (unitOf K a ha) (unitOf K b hb) = dB a b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.exists_eq_div
statement:
theorem exists_eq_div (x : Kˣ) :
    ∃ (a c : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0), x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extKHom_eq
statement:
theorem extKHom_eq {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a c : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    extKHom K f hf x = f a / f c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extKHom_unitOf
statement:
theorem extKHom_unitOf {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) : extKHom K f hf (unitOf K a ha) = f a

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extK_aux
statement:
theorem extK_aux {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a0 c0 a c : B} (ha0 : a0 ≠ 0) (hc0 : c0 ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h0 : x = unitOf K a0 ha0 * (unitOf K c0 hc0)⁻¹) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    f a0 / f c0 = f a / f c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extK_eq
statement:
theorem extK_eq {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a c : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    extK K f x = f a / f c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.finLen
statement: theorem finLen {z : B} (hz : z ≠ 0) : IsArtinian B (Qt z) ∧ IsNoetherian B (Qt z)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ker_mulMap
statement:
theorem ker_mulMap {z c w : B} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hw : w = c * z) :
    (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)) ⊓
        (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt w)).comap (mulMap z c w (by rw [hw])) ≤ ⊥

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ker_mulQ_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_mulQ_eq_range {x y z : B} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hz : z = x * y) :
    LinearMap.ker (mulQ z x) = LinearMap.range (mulQ z y)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.map_one_of_mul
statement:
theorem map_one_of_mul {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y) :
    f 1 = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.map_top_mulMap
statement:
theorem map_top_mulMap (z c w : B) (h : w ∣ c * z) :
    (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)).map (mulMap z c w h) = LinearMap.range (mulQ w c)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (z r : B) : (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) = 0 ↔ z ∣ r

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_mem_ker_mulQ
statement:
theorem mk_mem_ker_mulQ (z x r : B) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) ∈ LinearMap.ker (mulQ z x) ↔ z ∣ x * r

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_mem_range_mulQ
statement:
theorem mk_mem_range_mulQ {z y : B} (hy : y ∣ z) (r : B) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) ∈ LinearMap.range (mulQ z y) ↔ y ∣ r

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulMap_mk
statement:
theorem mulMap_mk (z c w : B) (h : w ∣ c * z) (r : B) :
    mulMap z c w h (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (c * r) : Qt w)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_comm
statement: theorem mulQ_comm (z x y : B) : mulQ z x ∘ₗ mulQ z y = mulQ z y ∘ₗ mulQ z x

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_mk
statement:
theorem mulQ_mk (z x r : B) :
    mulQ z x (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (x * r) : Qt z)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_mul
statement: theorem mulQ_mul (z x y : B) : mulQ z (x * y) = mulQ z x ∘ₗ mulQ z y

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.neg_one_pow_inv
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv {G : Type*} [Group G] [HasDistribNeg G] (k : ℕ) :
    ((-1 : G) ^ k)⁻¹ = (-1) ^ k

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ordZ_unitOf
statement:
theorem ordZ_unitOf {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ordZ B K (unitOf K a ha) = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Ring.ord B a).toNat : ℤ)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.pairing_ext
RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.perExact_symb
statement:
theorem perExact_symb {a b z : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hz : z = a * b) :
    PerExact (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt z)) ⊤ (mulQ z a) (mulQ z b)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.projMap_mk
statement:
theorem projMap_mk (z w : B) (h : w ∣ z) (r : B) :
    projMap z w h (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt w)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_eq
statement:
theorem symb_eq {a b z : B} (hz : z = a * b) (h0 : z ≠ 0) [IsArtinian B (Qt z)]
    [IsNoetherian B (Qt z)] :
    symb a b = perDet (M := Qt z) ⊥ ⊤ (mulQ z a) (mulQ z b)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_left
statement:
theorem symb_mul_left {a a' : B} (b : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    symb (a * a') b = symb a b * symb a' b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_right
statement:
theorem symb_mul_right (a : B) {b c : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    symb a (b * c) = symb a b * symb a c

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_symb_swap
statement: theorem symb_mul_symb_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : symb a b * symb b a = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_ne_zero
statement: theorem symb_ne_zero (a b : B) : symb a b ≠ 0

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_of_mul_eq_zero
statement: theorem symb_of_mul_eq_zero {a b : B} (h : a * b = 0) : symb a b = 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_self
statement:
theorem symb_self {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B a = n) :
    symb a a = (-1) ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_swap
statement: theorem symb_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : symb b a = (symb a b)⁻¹

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_unit
statement:
theorem symb_unit {u b : B} (hu : IsUnit u) (hb : b ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B b = n) :
    symb u b = residue B u ^ n

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_eq_smul
statement:
theorem unitOf_eq_smul (u : Rˣ) (k : ℕ) :
    (unitOf K ((u : R) * unif R ^ k) (mul_ne_zero u.ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _
      (irreducible_unif R).ne_zero)) : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ (k : ℤ)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_inj
statement:
theorem unitOf_inj {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (h : unitOf K a ha = unitOf K b hb) :
    a = b

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_mul
statement:
theorem unitOf_mul {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    unitOf K (a * b) (mul_ne_zero ha hb) = unitOf K a ha * unitOf K b hb

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.units_map_residue_neg_one
statement:
theorem units_map_residue_neg_one :
    Units.map (residue R : R →* ResidueField R) (-1) = -1
